timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: 1,511–1,560 KRW per USD

WHY: The won is currently WEAK (high KRW per USD), meaning dollars are expensive right now. News reports show the rate has surged to 1,560 won per dollar, with banks on emergency alert and analysts advising against excessive dollar conversion. The rate is volatile and elevated, making this an unfavorable window for your monthly $2,000 purchase.

TIP: Consider staggering smaller weekly conversions or waiting for a pullback below 1,500 won/USD if your monthly budget allows, since analysts expect the rate to eventually stabilize lower.
